API & contract

Panel-to-node wire contract v3.

Envelope

Every /sync/... call answers the same small envelope:

{"success": true, "msg": "...", "data": {...}}

A call is successful only on HTTP 200 and "success": true; business failures live inside the envelope, not as HTTP errors.

Handshake

  • Panel sends X-Contract-Version: 3 on every /sync call.
  • A node speaks contract v3 when GET /sync/status reports contract_version: 3.
  • A newer node (> 3) answers a typed 409 naming both versions; the panel surfaces it as an actionable notice, never silence.
  • The panel persists the last-seen version in nodes.node_contract_version on every successful poll (schema step 30).

Freeze rules

  • contract.json is additive-only. A shape change bumps the contract version.
  • No silent shape change within a version. max_logins omission rejects; it never defaults to 0/unlimited.
  • Unknown JSON fields are ignored by the node; the panel treats unrecognized totals_epochs shapes as unavailable, never zero.
